about_the_game:
Survive at Tamixa School in this horror adventure. Explore the mysterious place without losing your life or your sanity. Do your tasks without attracting the attention of the strange beings that roam inside and outside the building, while you sort out what's real from what's not.

 Welcome to CEIP Tamixa!

During the afternoons and evenings at this public school, Zamorano, a high school teacher, sees shadows that haunt him as he walks around the school. You will have to find out why Zamorano is being haunted and what he is doing there at Tamixa.

 The Cameras

The public school contains security cameras managed from the library computer. Access the images to find out where every shadow is lurking before you go outside the building.

 Survive

Do your tasks to avoid going crazy, avoiding the shadows lurking around the school to achieve your true mission and the reason you are at Tamixa.

DEMO Features

In this free trial of Julio's Adventure 3 you will be able to experience a generic night at Tamixa School. You will only be able to try the gameplay of one night made specifically for this trial, excluding the cinematics, story and narrative of the main game.
